site_ui.lead: Turn business bottlenecks into scoped AI services through paid audits, productized delivery, practical agent tests, and monthly support with clear operating boundaries.
site_ui.summary: All 12 chapters synthesize 192 verbatim YouTube practitioner testimonies with timestamped inline attribution, covering offer selection, design subscriptions, paid audits, retainers, prospecting, and client delivery. Practitioners compare automation platforms, test voice agents and retrieval systems, build customer-support workflows, and examine the costs, scope limits, privacy controls, and human handoffs behind those services.

Set Privacy, Contract, and Acceptance Boundaries
flow: Find a business willing to pay for a specific improvement in time, money, or focus; start with a small quick win rather than building workflows nobody wants.
Define the buyer, improve CRM data, and use referrals, LinkedIn, or targeted outreach to surface a concrete operational problem before pitching implementation.
Interview leaders and frontline staff, map the current workflow, confirm estimated savings with the client, and rank opportunities by impact and implementation effort.
Agree on deliverables, connected tools, payment terms, usage limits, privacy requirements, and acceptance criteria; then build the smallest useful automation, voice agent, or support workflow.
Test normal requests, interruptions, failures, retrieval quality, and human escalation; document the workflow and walk the client through credentials, operation, and recovery.

Package monitoring, maintenance, or ongoing improvements into explicitly bounded monthly service; control request queues and capacity, separate running costs, and route new features through change approval.
